result.title: SASFormer: Stage-Aware Selective Attention Transformer for All-in-One Blind Image Restoration
result.comment: Accepted by IEEE Transactions on Circuits and Systems for Video Technology
result.summary: All-in-one image restoration aims to recover high-quality images from multiple degradation types using a single unified model. Recent methods improve unified restoration with hybrid attention, prompt learning, or routing mechanisms, but generally focus on enhancing degradation adaptivity while employing similar feature modeling strategies across network stages. Consequently, the distinct representation requirements of encoding and decoding under diverse degradations remain insufficiently explored. In this paper, we propose SASFormer, a Stage-Aware Selective Attention Transformer for all-in-one blind image restoration. SASFormer follows a stage-aware design principle: the encoder uses established hybrid channel-spatial attention to build robust content-preserving and degradation-aware representations, while the decoder employs adaptive selective attention for restoration-oriented reconstruction. To address the stage-specific requirements of decoder reconstruction, we develop Adaptive Selective Channel Self-Attention (ASCSA) and Adaptive Selective Spatial Self-Attention (ASSSA), enabling the decoder to dynamically identify restoration-relevant channel responses and spatial contexts. Specifically, ASCSA performs adaptive query-channel selection and attention masking, while ASSSA adaptively integrates spatial attention across multiple window sizes. Compact implicit prompts further modulate the selection process without requiring explicit degradation labels. Extensive experiments on 3-, 5-, and 11-degradation settings demonstrate that SASFormer achieves strong restoration performance with favorable parameter efficiency. Moreover, stage-wise representation analysis and ablation studies provide empirical support for the proposed stage-aware design and the effectiveness of decoder-side adaptive selection.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 SASFormer，一种阶段感知的选择性注意力 Transformer，用于统一盲图像复原：编码器沿用混合通道-空间注意力保留内容并感知退化，解码器则用自适应选择通道/空间自注意力（ASCSA、ASSSA）配合隐式 prompt 动态挑选复原相关响应，在 3/5/11 类退化设定下验证效果与参数效率。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「编码阶段保留信息、解码阶段按需选择」的阶段差异化设计及无需退化标签的隐式 prompt 选择控制，可能为 LVR 中如何在不同推理阶段筛选任务相关视觉证据提供架构线索，需核查其选择机制是否可迁移。
